title: atomic_dec_if_positive guard on unregister: correct double-unregister protection
description: crypto2dev_unregister_provider() uses atomic_dec_if_positive() with a WARN(1,...) trap on the -1 return rather than atomic_dec(). This prevents the fips_provider_count from going negative on double-unregister, which would silently disable FIPS enforcement. The WARN fires a kernel splat to make the bug visible. A reviewer who suggests simplifying to atomic_dec() to 'clean it up' would introduce a silent FIPS bypass on buggy module_exit paths.
close_reason: Decision recorded. atomic_dec_if_positive guard on unregister — no code change needed.
